checks.summary: SpamAssassin scored -0.1. A default install treats 5 and above as spam.
checks.title: SpamAssassin score: -0.1

checks.summary: This letter asks the reader to confirm a subscription or an address. It is sent to one person about their own action, which the bulk-sender rules do not cover, so this check does not apply.
checks.title: Not a mailing: subscription confirmation

steps: Inventory every legitimate service that sends as formsubmit.co and confirm each passes aligned SPF or DKIM.
Review aggregate reports sent to the configured rua address and correct unidentified legitimate senders.
Publish p=quarantine for the organizational domain and subdomains.
After reports show legitimate traffic remains aligned, change p=quarantine and sp=quarantine to p=reject and sp=reject.
fixes.title: Move DMARC from monitoring to enforcement
fixes.why: The current p=none and sp=none policies collect reports but do not ask receivers to quarantine spoofed messages.

steps: Generate a meaningful plain-text version of the message body.
Send Content-Type: multipart/alternative with text/plain first and text/html second.
Put the core message, sender context, and essential link text in both parts.
Add visible HTML text rather than relying entirely on images, CSS backgrounds, or empty layout markup.
fixes.title: Send a multipart message with real text content
fixes.why: The message contains HTML but no text/plain alternative, and its HTML has a zero text ratio. Image-only or empty HTML is inaccessible and less robust across clients and filters.

problems.summary: Your policy is monitor-only, so receivers are told to do nothing about mail that fails. Move to p=quarantine once your reports look clean.

description: Test an email before you send it, with Email Spam Tester. Get a one-time address, send your real email to it from Gmail, Outlook or your sending service, and get a score with 42 checks: SPF, DKIM and DMARC, the sending server, SpamAssassin and Rspamd verdicts, content, and Gmail and Yahoo bulk sender rules, plus a fix plan ordered by points gained. An optional inbox placement test shows whether it lands in the inbox or spam at Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo and others. No account or API key required.
